765-2026-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
765-2026-2645-3430.description:
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

147-4875-8199.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Brigid's Command
147-4875-8199.description:
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Brigid's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Brigid's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-4875-8199.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

969-5078-5741-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3899-3912-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Khalni Garden.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Khalni Garden.
When Khalni Garden dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Khalni Garden enters, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

620-2111-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2350-2781-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

876-6274-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Endrider Catalyzer.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Endrider Catalyzer.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Endrider Catalyzer.
Activate Endrider Catalyzer by tapping it, adding {R}{R}
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Endrider Catalyzer.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Endrider Catalyzer.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Endrider Catalyzer from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

2523-2869-4991.description:
Activate Whisperwood Elemental by sacrificing it.
When Whisperwood Elemental dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Whisperwood Elemental that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Whisperwood Elemental ability.
Repeat using the Whisperwood Elemental token

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

280-1993-3259--85--106.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
280-1993-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
280-1993-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

165-1069-5499-7297.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-5499-7297.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3941-4331-4993-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3941-4331-4993-6709.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3215-5147-6871-6879.description:
Cast Bloodline Pretender by paying {3}.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodline Pretender.
When Bloodline Pretender dies, Haru triggers, returning Bloodline Pretender from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-4842-4908-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

5051-5078-6006-6918.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

101-500-1777.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Vampire Charmseeker and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Vampire Charmseeker tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a Vampire Charmseeker token, adding {B}{B} plus an additional amount of {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2. 
Repeat.

618-2511-3580.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2634-2997-5148.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Mountain, a basic Island and at least three other basic lands.
2634-2997-5148.description:
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Early Harvest
Resolve the Early Harvest copy, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

3705-5231-5997-6441.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating two 2/2 Alien Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warriors, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2060-2744-3327-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2060-2744-3327-5256.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dargo's power.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

3101-3705-5231-5997.manaNeeded: {R}{R}, plus an additional {3} minus {1} for each +1/+1 counter on Runaway Steam-Kin
3101-3705-5231-5997.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has tree or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa and Runaway Steam-Kin trigger.
Resolve the Iraxxa trigger, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Resolve the Runaway Steam-Kin trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

requires.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it
with a takeover counter on it

3967-5326--5--6.notablePrerequisites:
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of either the persist or undying creature.
The Master does not have a +1/+1 counter on it if it is a copy of the undying creature, or a -1/-1 counter on it otherwise.
3967-5326--5--6.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, if it was a copy of the undying creature, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the persist creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Otherwise, if The Master was a copy of the persist creature, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the undying creature with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness

116-283-4284.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Clone.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Clone and another permanent you control.
Activate Clone by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1385-1745-3054-4647-4871.description:
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's first ability by paying {B} and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger twice.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Lord of the Forsaken ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's second ability by paying 1 life, adding {C} that can only be spent to cast a spell from your graveyard.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1170-1171-1322.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-1322.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

2034-3197-3517.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Herd Baloth has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-3197-3517.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Tainted Observer triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Tainted Observer trigger, causing you to pay {2} to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

864-1170-1414-1482.description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color that can only be spent to cast your commander.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2541-2744.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2541-2744.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect creature token enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to draw a card, and then discard a card.
Repeat from step 2.

157-804-4608.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional enchantments.
157-804-4608.description:
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Detention Sphere that is a 3/3 legendary enchantment creature named Sakishima the Imposter.
When Sakashima the Impostor, it triggers its first ability from Detention Sphere, exiling itself.
Sakashima the Impostor leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability from Detention Sphere, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of Detention Sphere that is a 3/3 legendary creature named Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
End the loop by choosing a different creature to copy or a different permanent to exile, or by declining to exile anything.
